lines.en: Dew still hangs on the grass tips.
The birch bark shows pale beneath me.

lines.zh: 桦木林的水洼，映着天蓝。
lines.en: The birch puddle mirrors a blue sky.
I rise along the sunlight.
A dot of sky blue sits on my wings.
I am spring's first butterfly.

lines.zh: 我沿白桦林的花一路点过。
lines.en: I tap flower after flower along the birches.
Wings open, and I'm off.
The wind rolls in waves over the flower field.
The flowers along this path are in full bloom.
I know this flower field well.
A spiderweb hangs between the flowers.
I skim low over the ground hunting flowers.

lines.zh: 白桦叶子响，我就跟着转。
lines.en: When the birch leaves rustle, I turn with them.
Who muddied the water this color?
I'm flying lighter than a moment ago.
Sky blue shows through my wings.
The light over the field is slanting low.

lines.zh: 桦木林的水里，我等鱼群。
lines.en: In birch water, I wait for a school.
Dandelion fluff drifts past.

lines.zh: 桦木林的水边，我是淡蓝的。
lines.en: By the birch water, I'm pale blue.
A dewdrop mirrors my blue.
I stop on a birch twig.
The sun has warmed my wings.

lines.zh: 蓝色的翅，贴着桦树皮停。
lines.en: Blue wings resting on birch bark.
Only bees are humming far away.
A petal settles down beside me.
I count the flowers across the meadow.
There's a sweetness in the blossom.

lines.zh: 春天的花，开得比我飞得慢。
lines.en: Spring blooms open slower than I fly.

lines.zh: 桦木林的水，比你的泡大。
lines.en: The birch-wood pool has bigger bubbles than yours.
Should I hide, or watch?
A spring azure, trading stares with you.
Your shadow covers my flowers.

lines.zh: 桦木林的春天，由我先到。
lines.en: I bring spring to the birch grove first.

lines.zh: 你抬头，眼睛追着我的蓝翅。
lines.en: You look up, tracking my blue wings.

lines.zh: 你的帽子挡住了一片花。
lines.en: Your hat is shading a patch of flowers.
You have no wings and you can't fly.
You came walking from beyond the flowers.

lines.zh: 桦木林的水，你游得勉强。
lines.en: Birch-forest water. You swim poorly.
My wings feel heavier now.
One touch and the dust falls from my blue wings.
I rest a moment on a blade of grass.
The blow sent me spinning three times.
I can still beat my wings.
A layer of dust came off my wing.
Half the dust on my wings is gone.

lines.zh: 蓝翅上的粉，蹭了你一手。
lines.en: The dust from my blue wings is on your hand.

lines.zh: 我的蓝翅被压出一道褶。
lines.en: A crease is pressed into my blue wing.
Half of one antenna snapped off.

lines.zh: 桦树汁的甜，一点点就好。
lines.en: A little birch sap sweetness is enough.

lines.zh: 这蜜味是从你手里来的。
lines.en: That honey smell is coming from your hand.

lines.zh: 那朵花的味道飘过来了。
lines.en: The scent of that flower drifts over.

lines.zh: 花瓣铺了一地，我落上去。
lines.en: Petals cover the ground and I settle on them.

lines.zh: 白桦林里的甜味，飘过来了。
lines.en: Something sweet drifts through the birches.
There's a drop of sugar water in your palm.
I land on the back of your hand.
I'm the first one of spring.
You're holding the petal up high.
There's honey on your fingertip.
A gust flipped me end over end.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀边上卷了一点。
lines.en: The edge of my wing has curled a little.

lines.zh: 我翅上的蓝，是春天的颜色。
lines.en: The blue on my wings is the color of spring.
Spring-azure wings skim the water's top.
You stepped on the flowers beside you.

lines.zh: 桦木林的白皮上，我停一下。
lines.en: On birch bark I pause a moment.

lines.zh: 你的手指碰到了我的翅。
lines.en: Your finger touched my wing.

lines.zh: 一片花粉沾上你的袖子。
lines.en: Pollen dusted onto your sleeve.
You knocked my wing crooked.
You big ones — move aside.
A flash of sky blue in the birch wood.
Your wings are a shade whiter than mine.

lines.zh: 蓝卵我会一直护到孵化。
lines.en: I will guard the blue eggs until they hatch.
Under birch leaves my blue goes pale.
The birch bark will remember today.
Fly across these birches with me.

lines.zh: 这一季的花，我只看这一朵。
lines.en: This season I look at one bloom only.
You settle on the flower beside me.
We circle around the tree trunk.
My eggs are on the underside of a leaf.
I drag it low through the air.
I'll keep this drop of dew.
Why is there a scrap of cloth in the flowers?
I dab the pollen onto my legs.
There's something bright under the grass roots.

lines.zh: 白桦林里，我像一小片天空。
lines.en: In the birches I look like a scrap of sky.
I set it down on the stone.

lines.zh: 桦木林里，我一闪就是蓝的。
lines.en: In the birch woods, my blue flickers once.
I'll carry this petal back with me.
This flower's blue is much like mine.

lines.zh: 那朵花的花蕊露出来了。
lines.en: That flower's center is exposed now.
This clump will keep me all day.
The prey lifts a leg; so do I.

lines.zh: 桦树的白皮上，我落了一下。
lines.en: I rest a moment on a birch's white bark.
The wind carries the scent my way.
That petal is right in front of me.
An aphid is on the underside of the leaf.
This flower is finally opening.
That spring blossom must be mine.
Don't blink, among flowers it lasts a moment.
I skim low over the grass tips.

lines.zh: 桦木林的水洼，我也能追。
lines.en: I can chase you through birch puddles.

lines.zh: 桦木林里，我的蓝像春天。
lines.en: In the birch wood my blue looks like spring.
Left, then right. I circle.

lines.zh: 你我的距离正在缩短，别躲。
lines.en: Our distance is closing; do not dodge.
Chasing you beats chasing fish.
Wings closed, I fall like a leaf.
That dandelion hasn't opened yet.
You're standing at the edge of the flowers.
I circle the stem waiting for the wind to drop.
Spring-blue wings cut the surface.
The birch forest blooms are mine alone.
In the flower field I land lightest.
I kick at your finger with my legs.

lines.zh: 我这小翅，也能扫你一下。
lines.en: Even these small wings can swipe you.
Keep off my coral.

lines.zh: 花海的花一开，我就来了。
lines.en: When the flower sea blooms, I arrive.
Azure wings — and a quick strike.
You are quick, but my wings are quicker.
I bump into the hand you raised.
I crawl out from under a leaf.
Did I come here by myself?
My wings are still wet.
I fly one lap around the flower bed.
I've only landed on a blade of grass.
My antennae are still soft.
The birches are in flower.
The flower field is still. I land first.

lines.zh: 花海的浅水，刚够我翅尖沾湿。
lines.en: Flower-field shallows just wet my wingtips.
First I'll dry the damp off my back.
The heat has curled my wings.
I dropped from a grass tip onto stone.
A dewdrop has swallowed me whole.
Pollen bursts into the air.
A thorn has pierced my wing.
That spell on my scales leaves me cold.
Too weak to chew nectar.
At dusk I hide among the flowers.
There isn't a single flower here.
